paper.title: von Neumann Stability Analysis of Braginskii MHD Thermal Conduction, Viscosity, Magnetic Diffusion, and Thermoelectric Effects and an Implementation in Athena++

provenance.test_fixture: Dedicated Fourier-mode initializer and completed-cycle diagnostics; production transport code unchanged.

definitions.spatial_error: Maximum sampled volume-weighted velocity-vector L2 error over time; components combined in quadrature.
definitions.relative_spatial_error: Spatial error divided by initial cell-averaged velocity-vector RMS.
definitions.temporal_error: Final volume-weighted velocity-vector L2 difference from the H/32 run on the same N32 grid.
definitions.time_coordinate: clock_rate * time; clock_rate is the fastest active analytic decay rate.
